sentences.en: Our diplomacy and our military strategy were clearly in contradiction.
sentences.zh: 1. 我们的外交政策和军事战略显然是相矛盾的。

sentences.en: In terms of diplomacy, Algeria is a master chess player.
sentences.zh: 2. 在外交方面，阿尔及利亚是一个高明的棋手。

sentences.en: Our diplomacy and strategy ran in clear contradiction to each other.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们的外交政策和策略显然相互矛盾。

senses.zh: 外交, 外交手腕, 外交术交际手腕, 处世之道
